title: Claims-Experience Refund Share Schedule, Harbison 5-Year and 10-Year Labor Protection
content:
On the cancellation of a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, a claims-experience share applies by multiplication to the contract price in the refund. The share is set by the number of claims on the contract whose original decision approved or partially approved them, read from the contract's claim history.

| Claims on the contract approved or partially approved on their original decision | Claims-experience share |
|---|---|
| two or more | 0.85 |
| exactly one | 0.95 |
| none | 1 |

**Points of reading.**

- Only the original decision counts. A claim denied originally and approved on appeal is not counted; a claim approved originally is counted even if no payout has yet been made on it.
- A denied claim never counts.
- The count runs over the contract's whole history, with no time window.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A contract shows three claims: one approved, one partially approved and one denied on their original decisions. Two count: share 0.85.
